intro: Donmac ICT equips institutions and enterprises with the infrastructure, networks, security and software they depend on. As an HP Business Partner, an authorised Axiz reseller and an authorised distributor of Thales (Gemalto) digital identity solutions, we supply genuine, warranted technology and stay with it through installation, configuration and after-sales support.
